resources.string: Permissions and safety
SOSMesh is not a replacement for %1$s. Always call %1$s in emergencies.
Permissions before you start
SOSMesh needs Bluetooth and (on your Android version) notification permission to send SOS to nearby devices without internet. The app stays locked until all required permissions are granted.
Bluetooth: SOSMesh uses Bluetooth Low Energy to share SOS messages with nearby devices without internet. Without this permission, mesh scan cannot start.
Bluetooth scan (BLUETOOTH_SCAN): Required to discover nearby SOSMesh devices.
Bluetooth connect (BLUETOOTH_CONNECT): Required to open a GATT session to a discovered device.
Bluetooth advertise (BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE): Required so other devices can find you.
Location: On Android 11 and below, BLE scanning may require location permission.
Notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS): Required for the foreground mesh connection notification when relay mode is on. This is not operator read.
